messages.author: 5f2469cdcce60d61
messages.subject: 32bit only?
parts:
Hi All,

Is it possible to build a 32bit only package? my problem is I am using a third party library file which is 32bit, so I can only build a 32bit package (passing -m64 to the compile results in an error).

FYI, I am developing some internal tools for my firm, no intension to publish.

Best Regards,
Yue Zhao

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: 32bit only?
parts:
Yes, use `--no-multiarch` in the args to install/build etc.

Hadley

messages.subject: Re: 32bit only?
parts:
This should float into a FAQ somewhere: Maybe linked to the Readme.md on github or somewhere  people can find it?

1. Q: Error building on this architecture / Can I build only 32bit only package?
 * A: add  `--no-multiarch` in the args to install/build. e.g.
  'install_github("plyr", args = "--no-multiarch")'
2. ???


Happy to help keep this up to date if we find a place for it to live?

Hadley
